summary.result: Accordingly, establishment of waterproof mat for embankment showed that be absolutely effective for the embankment protection during overflow in reservoir.
summary.background: For overflow test, model dam was prepared and embankment behaviors were monitored with the established piezometer and strain meter during overflow.
summary.method: As a result of overflow test for model dam, in case of embankment without waterproof mat, the lower end of embankment was collapsed within 40 seconds after beginning of overflow.
